audits.strongest_pro_derivation_reading: Steelman, stated before audit as the field's own best case. The SM's fermion sector looks like a list of arbitrary answers: five chiral irreps per generation with five oddly specific rational hypercharges, which happen to satisfy four anomaly conditions in an apparent miracle. SO(10) with three 16s explains all of it at a stroke: the entire generation, RH neutrino included, is ONE irreducible object — the spinor of the smallest simple group that does this — and the miracle becomes a theorem, since SO(10) is a safe group with no anomaly conditions to check (Georgi-Glashow 1972). Charge quantization ceases to be an input: hypercharge is a generator of a compact simple group, its spectrum on the 16 fixed by group theory — and this forces precisely the coordinate that SM-internal consistency provably leaves free (the Babu-Mohapatra B-L flat direction). Three gauge couplings collapse to one, quantitatively supported by unification in the SUSY case; gauged B-L delivers the seesaw and neutrino mass as outputs rather than appendices. The minimal SUSY version even claims a leaner total Lagrangian than the MSSM it produces: 25 parameters (15 Yukawa + 10 superpotential; Aulakh et al. 2004) with exact R-parity predicted. On this reading, the fermion-sector specification content of the SM is not merely reorganized but derived from a single supplied item, the choice '16 of SO(10), thrice' — the closest thing to a genuine S-elimination for a subsector anywhere in physics, and the reason A1 carries the highest falsification pressure on principle II in the round.

(4) Doublet-triplet splitting is a new supplied item with no SM analogue: a 1:10^14 tuning or dedicated extra structure (Babu-Barr 1993). (5) Generation number, gravity, theta, and the actual vacuum selection pass through or remain supplied. Adjudication under the charter's classes: not ELIMINATION — S-prime does not carry strictly less supplied content same-map at honest typing; it carries more at every type except discrete rep content, and the extraordinary-evidence bar is nowhere approached since every minimal realization is excluded or driven to enlarged structure. Not mere RELOCATION — the rep-content compression and the coincidences-to-theorems conversion are real and must be credited.
